_comment: Manual QA deck for inline reference viewers and media embeds. Keep this deck up to date whenever Slidey adds a new reference kind, media viewer, or embeddable scene source.

scenes.title: Embed QA
scenes.subtitle: single deck for inline references and media viewers

scenes.title: Reference viewer matrix
scenes.caption: The rest of this deck embeds concrete references inline. The rail remains as a secondary navigation path.

scenes.body: Click the underlined words: a Markdown link opens the reference viewer, and an HTML link renders in a sandboxed iframe instead of as source. Escape or a backdrop click dismisses either. A deck: target (see README) would switch slides instead of opening a modal.
scenes.bodyHtml: Click the underlined words: a Markdown link opens the reference viewer, and an HTML link renders in a sandboxed iframe instead of as source. Escape or a backdrop click dismisses either. A deck: target (see README) would switch slides instead of opening a modal.

scenes.title: Markdown section preview
scenes.caption: Click the Markdown preview: the slide shows one section, the modal opens the full Markdown file.

scenes.title: sample.js

annotations.text: The slide shows a linked line range from the full file.

scenes.caption: Click the code block: the modal opens the complete source and highlights the linked lines.

scenes.title: Proposed code change
scenes.caption: Click the diff preview: the modal shows the full unified diff, and View Diff opens the patch through the current host.

scenes.title: Graph reference
scenes.source:
flowchart LR
  A[Scene] --> B[Reference chips]
  B --> C[Inline viewer]
  C --> D[Close and return]
scenes.caption: The rendered graph is a Mermaid scene; the chip opens the source file as a graph/plugin-style reference.

scenes.title: Image media
scenes.caption: Click the image itself to open it larger in the modal; the rail chip is only a secondary path.

scenes.title: Image comparison media
scenes.caption: Click either comparison panel to inspect that image independently in the modal.

scenes.title: Local video fixture
scenes.caption: The MP4 scene and reference chip should both play the same tiny fixture.

scenes.title: DOM session fixture
scenes.caption: The scene should mount the rrweb player; the chip should open the rrweb JSON source.

scenes.tagline: Keep examples/embed-qa.slidey.json current with every new embed or reference viewer.
